notes.title: Battle Planet: Judgement Day - Asia Launch Patch!
notes.content:
We’ve partnered up with publisher Ripples to bring Battle Planet: Judgement Day to even more players specifically for the asian regions! We hope our community from across the globe will be able to enjoy shooting endless hordes of aliens, robots and boss monsters for hours and hours to come!

We also took the opportunity to polish the game further and added lots of additional fixes - see our patch notes below for more details.

Wishing everyone happy holidays, a very great start into 2024 and a ton of shmup fun with Battle Planet - Judgement Day!

[u][b]Language updates: [/b][/u]

[b]Added Languages:[/b]
Korean
Japanese
Thai
Indonesian
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese 

[u][b]Game Improvements: [/b][/u]

Feature: Added Menu-Navigation with Arrow keys
Feature: In Coop mode, the Boss Introduction will now be shown on both screens
Gameplay change: Upon entering the Escape Pod, players will now immediately leave the planet

[u][b]System Improvements:[/b][/u]

Fix: It is no longer possible to bind the same key to both jetpack and item use
Fix: The game will no longer freeze after a Boss introduction
Fix: Holding the teleport on the spy when the round ends will no longer stop the progression of the round
Fix: Language change will now change all Languages immediately instead of the next round 
Fix: When Using a Mouse & Keyboard, some Tutorial prompts have been changed to the correct controls 
Fix: The Perk “Extra Rounds” now correctly starts with the full amount of ammunition when carrying a special weapon over to a new planet 
Fix: When hitting a wall while dying, the respawn spot and the physical body are now aligned with each other properly
Fix: Multiple minor issues in Menu Navigation were fixed
Fix: Multiple in-game fonts have been adjusted
Fix: Fixed a graphical issue with the jetpack
Fix: Fixed multiple graphical issues involving flickering textures or game elements
Fix: Fixed a graphical issue where the 2nd Player had moving shadows on their screen, reflecting on the 1st Player's screen

notes.title: Tilt Five Patch: support for local co-op
notes.content:
Greetings, exciting adventurers! Hold onto your seats because we've got some exciting news to unleash upon you!

Prepare for a wild ride because we are thrilled to announce that we've brought the local co-op experience in Battle Planet for Tilt Five! Get ready to dive into the action with Multiglasses and Mixcast, now fully integrated into the game! (Whoop, whoop!)

But that's not all, folks! We've cranked up the excitement by updating the Tilt Five driver to version 1.3.3! We've even added a handy reminder to make sure your Tilt Five drivers stay as fresh as the game itself. Plus, we've vanquished a pesky bug that had the audacity to mix up players and glasses, making the Player 2 control the Player 1 control and vice versa. Say goodbye to the glasses-swapping chaos when the game starts!

notes.title: Bugfix Patch: Revive Mechanic & Projectile Visibility
notes.content:
A small update patch that addresses some bugs related to cooperative gameplay. This patch fixes some issues that were disruptive when playing with a friend and made Coop not function properly. 
Now, cooperative play will be fully fun and functional again. 

[b][h3]Bug-Fixes[/h3][/b] [list]

[*] Fixed revive mechanic in coop, you can now properly revive each other again 
[*] Fixed visibility of projectiles for player 2 [/list]
[b]Fixed Revive:[/b] Previously, players were unable to revive their buddy, resulting in a frustrating soft lock. We made sure this issue is resolved and you can get up and fighting again consistently! 

[b]Fixed Projectile Visibility:[/b] When playing on Split Screen, Player 2 would not be able to see any projectiles shot, just the lights which should follow the bullets. This, of course, is very disadvantageous with how many projectiles fly around the screen at all times. Now, all projectiles will be visible again when joining a friend as a partner in crime. Fire away! 

As always, if you encounter any issues or have feedback, let us know on Discord or here on Steam.

[b]Left:[/b] Old Version with invisible Projectiles for Player 2 
[b]Right:[/b] Fixed Projectiles on new Patch

notes.title: Patch-Notes for May 11th 2022
notes.content:
This patch is mostly focussed on upgrading the internal SDK and fixing some issues for the Tilt Five version of the game, as well as some general issues.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Upgraded Tilt Five SDK version
[*] Added an infographic with recommended playing pose for Tilt Five
[*] Added a brightness slider for Tilt Five
[/list]

[b]Bug-Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] In rare occasions, weapons and other pickups were able to spawn "too high" for the player, making them inaccessible. This is now fixed.
[*] You're no longer able to pause the game during introductions of enemies, weapons and such, which resulted in an overlap of the pause menu while running the game
[*] When pausing the game, without giving any further input and then Alt+Tab to another program and then back into the game, the pause menu was auto-closing and the game continued. It now stays paused as it should.
[*] Improved stability of input devices on Tilt Five: Previously, the priority and order of devices used hasn't been great for Tilt Five, for instance when connecting a controller but playing with the wand, you saw wrong iconography for controls. Additionally, the input of the wand has not always been registered correctly, which should be fixed as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Battle Planet Is Now Tilt Five Enabled
notes.content:
This patch features an exciting update to our game: Battle Planet - Judgement Day is now officially Tilt Five enabled! This means, if you have a Tilt Five, you get to experience our game as a hologram. We are super happy with the result and the way it looks on the Game Board. To celebrate the occasion, we also made a bunch of visual improvements, addressed some outstanding bugs and added suggested features, such as a warning screen for when you leave a planet with remaining XP on it. 

[h1]Tilt Five Support![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35493203/475d9fff51e69722923ece9c130a05230225b8f2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The game is fully Tilt Five enabled! Connect your Tilt Five glasses and get to experience Battle Planet - Judgement Day as a hologram at home! 
[*] Controller Support
[list]
[*] The game is playable with the Tilt Five Wand Controller, supporting horizontal orientation
[*] Additionally, your regular gamepads or keyboard & mouse should work just fine too[/list]
[*] Detection Backend
[list]
[*] We want to make using the Tilt Five as easy as possible for you! When you connect your glasses in the main menu, the game will ask you whether to use them or not
[*] You can enable/disable using the glasses at all times via the options menu
[*] Switching between Tilt Five & Default Mode is possible in-between planets - you do not have to quit the game or restart your run![/list]
[*] Unfortunately co-op mode is not supported in Tilt Five due to the need of a second pair of glasses and a second PC.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099170/Battle_Planet__Judgement_Day/
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Support for Steam Cloud Saves[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] We tweaked the balancings of various weapons & items to make them more powerful & engaging throughout the gameplay
[list]
[*] Weapons: Boomerang, Electro Shocker, Gatling Gun, Rocket Launcher, Shotgun
[*] Items: Freeze Mine, Gravity Mine, Adrenaline, Shield
[*] This affects their base values as well as their upgrades[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] We improved a bunch of VFX & Textures in the game, such as...
[list]
[*] … projectile VFX
[*] … spawn VFX for the police faction
[*] … added VFX to items to make them more visible
[*] … improved combat & ability VFX for the spy
[*] … texture touch up on most planet surfaces
[*] … improved lava visuals[/list]
[*] We added a small blinking effect to xp right before they disappear to indicate that you need to collect them quickly
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved Shotgun sound
[/list]
[h2]UI/UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Possibility to restore the games settings to default
[*] You can choose to skip already seen boss introductions now
[*] Leaving a planet with XP left triggers a dialogue prompt to ensure no XP are left behind unwillingly
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Medkits no longer drop in unfortunate, unreachable positions
[*] XP are always consumed correctly now
[*] When playing co-op, you could see the hurt fx of the other player overlap on your screen. This is now fixed.
[*] Sometimes the pause menu auto-closed when using the ESC key, this is now fixed
[*] Shotgun weapon now also gets its introduction once seen
[*] The hub sometimes spawned the same item twice, when you unlocked a new one. This is now fixed!
[/list]

notes.title: Release Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35493203/af97c7214a0396411979a6746cf8c64148e4b023.jpg[/img]

We are proud to announce the release of Battle Planet - Judgement Day ....today!

If you're looking out for super fast paste, crazy top down, twin stick bullethell action, this game is definitely worth a try!

Battle Planet - Judgement Day is a planetary rogue-lite top-down shooter. You are one of the universe's 3 most wanted criminals on the run, fighting your way through hordes of aliens, military and police units. There is only one way to reclaim your freedom - destroy them all...

[previewyoutube=_9XMvNYxocI;full][/previewyoutube]

Key Features:
[list]
[*]couch co-op mode: die together in excessive sessions with friends
[*]permanently upgrade your convict and the weapon arsenal after each run
[*]battle your way through hordes of enemies designed to torment you
[*]power up your ass with a load-out of perks
[*]face bosses that have your controller buttons on their death list
[/list]

We wish everybody a great time playing the game and please let us know if you have any feedback so we can make sure to achieve the best game possible for everyone!

Greets from the THREAKS team!
